stories.title: Asiad enters its penultimate day
stories.body: India sits 5th with 76 medals (16 gold, 25 silver, 35 bronze) after a six-gold surge on 2 October, edging ahead of Uzbekistan on total medals. Today (3 October) brings two blockbuster finals: men's T20 cricket, India vs Pakistan (10:00 am IST) and men's hockey, India vs Malaysia (3:30 pm IST) — the hockey final also carries a direct LA 2028 Olympic berth — plus medal action in archery, wrestling and golf.

stories.title: Parinaaz Dhaliwal's skeet double bronze
stories.body: the skeet shooter took two bronzes: the women's skeet team bronze (score 331) with Raiza Dhillon and Maheshwari Chauhan — India's first-ever women's skeet team medal at the Asian Games — and the mixed team skeet bronze with Anantjeet Singh Naruka (44 hits across six series; tied with South Korea but took bronze on qualification-ranking tie-break).

stories.title: Shooting campaign closes with 15 medals
stories.body: India's shooters finished with 3 gold, 8 silver and 4 bronze, below the record 22 of Hangzhou; trap shooter Neeru Dhanda was the standout (2 gold, 1 silver). In compound archery, Chikitha Taniparthi lost the women's individual quarterfinal 143-144; India lost the men's volleyball quarterfinal 0-3 to Pakistan, ending medal hopes in the event for the first time since 1986.

stories.title: Gujarat's UCC gets Presidential assent
stories.body: President Droupadi Murmu gave assent to the Gujarat Uniform Civil Code, 2026, notified as Gujarat Act No. 15 of 2026 (Gazette Extraordinary published 1 October; assent given 17 September). Gujarat becomes the second state after Uttarakhand to enact a UCC. Key points: common law on marriage, divorce, succession and live-in relationships; marriage registration mandatory within 60 days (fine up to ₹10,000); live-in relationships must be registered (up to ₹10,000 fine or 3-month jail for non-registration); equal inheritance for sons and daughters; Scheduled Tribes exempt. Drafted by a five-member panel under retired SC judge Justice Ranjana Prakash Desai; Bill passed 24 March.

stories.title: UPSC completes 100 years: 'Manthan'
stories.body: the Union Public Service Commission held centenary celebrations titled 'Manthan' on 30 September–1 October at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi. Lineage: 1855 ICS exam (first Indian ICS officer Satyendranath Tagore) → 1922 first ICS exam in India → 1924 Lee Commission → 1926 Public Service Commission → constitutional body under Articles 315–323.

stories.title: New Environment Secretary
stories.body: Narendra Bhooshan (IAS, 1992 batch, UP cadre) assumed charge as Secretary, Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change.

stories.title: Delhi HC orders takedown of deepfake content against Drishti IAS founder
stories.body: Justice Anup Jairam Bhambhani directed removal of fake social-media profiles and deepfake videos impersonating Vikas Divyakirti (founder, Drishti IAS), noting personality-rights protection; Meta agreed to remove 11 of 13 offending URLs.

stories.title: Kotak Mahindra Bank: Anup Kumar Saha as MD & CEO
stories.body: the RBI approved the appointment on 1 October 2026 (GKToday, 1 Oct banking news) — a second major private-bank leadership change this week after HDFC Bank's Anup Bagchi.

stories.title: High-level banking panel likely by October-end
stories.body: the government is likely to announce a 10-member committee on banking for Viksit Bharat 2047 (part of the 2026-27 Budget announcements) with public and private-sector representation; names under consideration include former RBI Deputy Governor Michael Patra, former Financial Services Secretary M. Nagaraju and former SBI chairman Dinesh Khara, plus IBA, fintech and EAC-PM voices.

stories.title: SatLeo's TAPAS-1 lifts off
stories.body: Ahmedabad-based spacetech startup SatLeo Labs launched its thermal-imaging satellite TAPAS-1 on 1 October; the 3-kg payload flew aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9.

stories.title: IICT signs five MoUs for AVGC-XR
stories.body: the Indian Institute of Creative Technologies signed five MoUs on 30 September at FICCI FRAMES 2026, Mumbai to build the AVGC-XR (Animation, Visual Effects, Gaming, Comics – Extended Reality) ecosystem.

stories.title: New fish species in Bay of Bengal
stories.body: Bathymyrus perplexus, identified by the Zoological Survey of India (ZSI) unit at Gopalpur, is a newly recognised fish species from the Bay of Bengal.

stories.title: Two new islands after Anak Krakatau eruption
stories.body: mariners spotted two new islands off Indonesia's Anak Krakatau volcano following a 25-hour continuous eruption between 4 and 6 September 2026.

stories.title: CHIME telescope sees the early universe
stories.body: Canada's CHIME telescope detected the faint glow of hydrogen from the early universe. Japan's Fukutoku-Okanoba volcano was also in the news.

stories.title: ASEAN–India Maritime Exercise 2026
stories.body: the second edition of AIME began on 28 September at Subic Bay, the Philippines; Indian Naval Ships INS Sahyadri and INS Kulish are participating.

stories.title: California bans child marriage
stories.body: the first US state to do so, through Assembly Bill 1267, which sets 18 years as the minimum age for marriage.

stories.title: World Congress of Gastroenterology 2026
stories.body: WCOG 2026 is being held in New Delhi from 1–3 October.

stories.title: National Voluntary Blood Donation Day 2026
stories.body: this year's theme is "One Drop of Humanity. Give Blood. Save Lives."

stories.title: Men's cricket gold: India beat Pakistan by 19 runs
stories.body: the defending champions posted 211/6 in the final at Korogi Sports Park, Nisshin, powered by fifties from Abhishek Sharma (61) and Tilak Varma (51*); Pakistan replied 192/6 despite Hasan Nawaz's 96. The 403-run aggregate is the highest ever in an India-Pakistan T20I. India completed a cricket double gold — the women's team had beaten Sri Lanka by 147 runs on 22 September. Sri Lanka took bronze with a 63-run win over Bangladesh.

stories.title: Men's hockey gold: India beat Malaysia 5-1
stories.body: India's fifth Asian Games men's hockey gold (1966, 1998, 2014, 2022, 2026) and its first successful back-to-back title defence. Captain Harmanpreet Singh struck a brace (11', 57'), with Jugraj Singh (23'), Hardik Singh (42', penalty stroke) and Shilanand Lakra (54'); Malaysia replied through Shello Silverius (14'). The win earned direct qualification for the LA 2028 Olympics — and with the women's team having beaten China 1-0 on 2 October, India won men's and women's hockey gold at the same Asian Games for the first time ever (hockey becomes the third Indian team sport with a double gold, after kabaddi and cricket).

stories.title: Aman Sehrawat strikes wrestling gold
stories.body: Aman Sehrawat beat DPR Korea's world champion Han Chong Song 11-7 in the men's 57kg freestyle final, fighting back from 6-7 down with a decisive four-point move; he is the first Indian to win the 57kg title (he had won bronze at Hangzhou 2023). His gold follows Sujeet Kalkal's 65kg gold on 2 October (10-9 over Tajikistan's Abdulmazhid Kudiyev) — India's first two men's freestyle golds since 1978. Antim Panghal took silver in the women's 53kg, losing 9-1 to Japan's Moe Kiyooka.

stories.title: More Day 15 golds — golf & archery
stories.body: Pranavi Urs clinched gold in women's individual golf; Kumkum Mohod won women's individual recurve archery gold. In men's golf, South Korea's Tom Kim took gold, earning exemption from compulsory military service — the reward South Korea grants Asian Games champions.

stories.title: India end Day 15 with 85 medals, 4th in the table
stories.body: with three more golds on Saturday, India's tally reached 85 medals (21 gold, 27 silver, 37 bronze), leapfrogging Uzbekistan into 4th place on the gold/silver count. The final order will only be settled on Sunday (4 October) — Uzbekistan still have an equestrian event left.

stories.title: CCEA approves record Rabi MSPs
stories.body: the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs approved higher Minimum Support Prices for all mandated Rabi crops for the 2027-28 marketing season, at 50–106% above the all-India weighted average cost of production: wheat up ₹25 to ₹2,610/quintal, safflower up ₹675 to ₹7,215, rapeseed & mustard up ₹413 to ₹6,613, lentil/masur up ₹390 to ₹7,390. Separately, MSP procurement of pulses and oilseeds worth ₹5,547.99 crore (~7.06 lakh tonnes) was cleared for Kharif 2026-27 in Uttar Pradesh, Karnataka and Telangana. The CCEA also approved a ₹1,789-crore intelligent traffic system for Delhi.

stories.title: Windfall tax cut on fuel exports
stories.body: effective 1 October, the Finance Ministry cut the SAED on diesel exports to ₹16/litre (from ₹20) and on ATF exports to ₹10.5/litre (from ₹15); petrol exports remain at ₹0.5/litre for the fortnight. The levies — imposed in March 2026 amid West Asia tensions to protect domestic fuel availability — are revised fortnightly; domestic levies are unchanged.

stories.title: Green Energy Corridor Phase-III approved
stories.body: the Union Cabinet cleared GEC-III with an outlay of ₹1.86 lakh crore to build intra-state transmission systems capable of evacuating 135 GW of renewable energy by FY 2032-33.

stories.title: 'Mann Ki Baat' turns 12
stories.body: the PM's monthly radio programme completed 12 years on 3 October 2026 (launched 3 October 2014, Vijayadashami day); the 138th episode aired on 27 September 2026.

stories.title: Odisha rewards the hockey queens
stories.body: Odisha Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi announced a ₹11 lakh cash award each for the members (and support staff) of the Indian women's hockey team that beat China 1-0 to win gold.

one_liners: Asian Games Day 15 (3 Oct): India 76 medals (16G/25S/35B), 5th; today: cricket final India vs Pakistan (10 am IST), hockey final India vs Malaysia (3:30 pm IST); women's skeet team bronze (331 — first-ever), mixed skeet bronze (Dhaliwal + Anantjeet Singh Naruka); shooting campaign ends with 15 medals, Neeru Dhanda 2G/1S.

Gujarat UCC: assent 17 Sept, notified as Gujarat Act No. 15 of 2026; 2nd state after Uttarakhand; marriage registration within 60 days; live-in registration mandatory; STs exempt; panel under Justice Ranjana Prakash Desai.
UPSC @ 100: centenary 'Manthan', 30 Sept–1 Oct, Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi; Lee Commission 1924; first Indian ICS officer Satyendranath Tagore; Articles 315–323.
New Environment Secretary: Narendra Bhooshan (IAS 1992, UP cadre).
Delhi HC: takedown of fake profiles/deepfakes impersonating Vikas Divyakirti (Drishti IAS founder); Justice Anup Jairam Bhambhani.
Banking moves: Anup Kumar Saha to head Kotak Mahindra Bank (RBI nod 1 Oct); 10-member Viksit Bharat banking panel likely by October-end (2026-27 Budget announcement).
Space & tech: SatLeo's TAPAS-1 (3-kg thermal-imaging payload) on SpaceX Falcon 9 (1 Oct); IICT signs 5 MoUs at FICCI FRAMES 2026, Mumbai for AVGC-XR.

Environment: Bathymyrus perplexus — new fish species, Bay of Bengal (ZSI Gopalpur); two new islands off Anak Krakatau after 25-hour eruption (4–6 Sept); CHIME (Canada) sees early-universe hydrogen glow; Fukutoku-Okanoba volcano (Japan) in news.

World: AIME-2026 (2nd edition) at Subic Bay, Philippines — INS Sahyadri, INS Kulish; California first US state to ban child marriage (age 18); WCOG 2026 in New Delhi (1–3 Oct); Blood Donation Day theme — "One Drop of Humanity. Give Blood. Save Lives."
